[ticket-viewer][viewer-api] Preserve graph layout and camera across same-graph refreshes

fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. Reapplying the same workspace graph payload preserves dragged node positions instead of snapping back to the backend layout. 2. Switching focused graph nodes inside the mounted graph preserves the current layout arrangement when the underlying graph topology is unchanged. 3. Focus changes retarget the camera without resetting the user's current zoom level.
fields.implementation_summary: Shared Graph3D sync now preserves dragged node positions when the incoming layout keeps the same graph topology and layout mode, while selection autofocus retargets the camera using the current distance instead of reframing the graph. The ticket-viewer graph regression suite now drags a node, changes focus inside the mounted graph, and asserts both the relative layout offsets and the exposed camera distance stay stable.
